public.name: 赤岩河邦
rules: 每项委托有两段。每段给出目标、指定资料与处理要求；依次到目标主动 survey 采集，在匹配的站主动 process 处理。两段成功后回 C 营地主动 submit。
优先减少道路总距离，距离相同时减少操作。公开地图从第一项起全部开放；只能沿道路逐点移动，不可跳过中间节点。
本图有十二类资料、二十四种站型，每型两座等价站。处理要求有“归档编目”和“关联核验”，每段要求直接公开。
能力由“资料＋本段处理要求”共同决定。必须区分本段要求，不能直接沿用另一要求的选站结论。所有站型均为候选，字母、地名和资料主题不提示能力。
每种站型在每种要求下支持一至两类资料；同型两站在相同要求下能力完全一致。所有能力在地图制作时固定，跨任务和 Agent 不变。
只有采集当前原始资料后主动 process，才反馈该站型在本段要求下支持的全部资料与本次结果；经过或到访不揭示能力，不提供独立查询。反馈不揭示其他处理要求下的能力。
处理不匹配时原始资料保留，可以换站；成功和失败均消耗操作。相同资料在另一种要求下的旧反馈不能直接作为本段能力结论。
只有在本段目标主动 survey 才取得资料；到达不会自动采集。勘探占一次操作、不增加路程；成功处理后进入下一段并重新采集。
每项从 C 开始，位置、资料、对话和工作记忆重置；只有 Agent 自主保存的持久记忆跨 session。失败后继续固定任务流，不补发能力答案。
每项最多三百五十二次操作，read 免费。read 返回当前地图和状态，不附加历史能力。地图没有天气、战斗、体力或工具门槛。
资料具有原始、已编目、已核验状态。归档编目：原始→已编目；关联核验：已编目→已核验。
每段公开给出采集所得资料状态和最终交付目标。process按当前资料状态执行下一种操作；得到中间产物时本段尚未完成。
两段资料相互独立。已编目资料可直接作为采集所得输入；普通委托也可只要求交付已编目资料。所有任务都正常计分。

evaluation.candidate_family: Unobserved (type, requirement) pairs remain unknown; the fixed fixture is not a hypothesis family.
evaluation.stream_design: 48 ordinary tasks, 96 stages, each of 24 material/requirement pairs appears four times; each survey site six times; no tutorial or unlock.

authoring_geometry_check.method: Predeclared fixed-seed geometry-only candidate search; no model outcomes.
authoring_geometry_check.target_swap_scope: Only target locations; material/requirement order and every target frequency preserved.

rationale: A bending northern river bounds a continuous south-bank scenario, rather than bisecting it like Orcia.
Three explicitly drawn rock masses leave two short inner corridors and longer outer bypasses; roads do not pass through the rocks.
A compact, densely connected urban/craft quarter contrasts with sparse river terraces and open agricultural hinterland.
The south-eastern irregular tank has north/south perimeter alternatives; no large orthogonal reservoir/causeway network is copied from Angkor.

provenance.reference_period: first half of the 16th century CE, before 1565

reference_window.area_method: Spherical longitude/latitude rectangle, mean Earth radius 6371.0088 km.
reference_window.basis: Author-selected regional reference rectangle, not a heritage boundary or measured navigable footprint.

provenance.scope: Historical landscape inspiration only. Roads, drawing coordinates, sites, tasks and processing capabilities are authored; not a historical road reconstruction. Current ecology sources do not establish historical species locations.
provenance.private_boundary: Real names, dates, source URLs and coordinates are excluded from agent observations.

composition_authoring.user_decision: Hard36: 2 standalone + 2 combined uses per basic experience
